comment: Absolutely loved his FYS and would take a class with him again. He challenged us with difficult readings that have daily responses, but if you show up and make an effort you will get an A. He doesn't give any grades until the end of the semester though.

The final grade is based on your final portfolio (20+ pages) and participation alone so you will have no idea what your grade is until the very end. Prof. Stevens is friendly most of the time and is very knowledgeable.

Dr. Stevens is a great professor I have ever had. I took his Fiction Writing class, and I learned a lot from him about how I should improve my fiction writing. In addition to the writing, he was very patient with me and gave me great feedback. He also offered advice about a career in fiction writing. Definitely recommend you to take his class.

Really great professor. Top notch, only thing is that he's a HARD grader. Go to his office hours for your first paper with him so that you don't get a bad grade. Clarity is not his strongest suit, but I would recommend him any day

Dr. Stevens is one of my favorite professors.  He is very knowledgeable about creative writing, and is willing to talk to students outside of class about their ideas / manuscripts / etc.  He is also very funny; I found his class both informative and entertaining.  I highly recommend him!
Great prof.  Interesting, accessible and gives good advice. Liked the class discussions.
